scope: Original recording versus known old APK baseline only; no new U package inference. Native decoded image pixels, not pt/dp/CSS.
coordinates: [x0,y0,x1,y1), source top-left origin, right and bottom excluded. Mask bounds measure retained pixels; compressed antialiased outer control bounds are separate estimates.

masks.gold_strict: R>140 and G>95 and B<0.65*R and R>1.06*G
masks.gold_loose: R>140 and G>95 and B<0.80*R and R>1.03*G
masks.search237: min(R,G,B)>=200 and max(R,G,B)<=244 and R<237 and G<237
masks.search234: min(R,G,B)>=200 and max(R,G,B)<=242 and R<234 and G<234

row_measurement.original_main_card_bottom: clipped by fixed footer; not a measured full card height

system_exclusions.original_exclusion_status: Analysis convention for visible status/home-indicator zones, not measured physical safe-area bounds or original logical viewport. Video has no hardware frame.

optional_top_anchor_transform.formula: x_a=s*x_o; y_a=83+s*(y_o-28); s=1080/224. Comparison aid only; never use for zero-diff.

excluded_states.reason: Returning/scrolling state: duplicated centered navigation title plus gray large title, shifted search/cards. Not paired with stable top state.

nonconclusions: No whole-image zero difference; different row counts/accounts/content and system chrome.
No Android dp/CSS/iOS points or physical safe-area dimensions inferred from image sizes.
No current/new U APK runtime or pixel validation.
No smart-folder mobile form evidence in original recording.
No tag-section absence inferred from original clipped long folder list.
